g.text: Following is what makes plain timed execution fragile: if L is a little late, M drives into W12 while L is still there. The type-2 edges of an ADG exist exactly to order such hand-overs (L must

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: finish leaving before M starts entering).
